annotations.title: Hand a DM back to automations

description: Close someone's ask for a person (they DMed HUMAN): automated DMs may write to them again. A conversation the ask held picks up where it was; one waiting for a tap or an email waits again. Contacts with an open ask show handoff_at in dm_contacts_list.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: dm_handoff_close
